decision_set_provenance: Post-primary implementation amendment dated 2026-08-26; fixed before module-level leave-one-batch sensitivity. The original analysis lock covers all 13 modules, not this subset; no immutable external preregistration timestamp exists.
rule: Downgrade if a module in the post-primary fixed nomination set reverses direction in a leave-one-batch-out rotation fit, or if a full-analysis decision-set module with BH q<=0.10 loses BH q<=0.10 when one batch is omitted (single-block dependence). Reversals in other configured modules are diagnostic only.
note: Module-level maxmean fits use 9,999 rotations and BH across the same 13 modules. Direction-driver overlap is a descriptive diagnostic, not a formal leading edge. A direction reversal of a module without full-analysis BH support is descriptive instability, not statistically meaningful enrichment evidence. With only three pairs, no exact permutation p<0.05 is claimed. Gene-level Spearman does not set this verdict.
module_inference_boundary: Leave-one-batch stability is an influence check only. Zero of 12 evaluable primary modules (13 configured) reach BH q<=0.10; stability must not be interpreted as mitochondrial, proteostasis, or other module enrichment evidence.
